news.title: Missing World Cup soccer? Ted Lasso Season 4 is giving football fans their fix
news.lede: The World Cup ended a few weeks ago. For plenty of fans, ordinary life still hasn't quite recovered. Across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, creators are posting nostalgic edits, empty stadiums and montages of the month that seemed to disappear almost as quickly as it arrived. In the comments, people are talking about missing the daily rhythm of matches, the crowds, the travel and even the strange feeling of having half the world watching the same thing at the same time.
